name: MultiTableInsertIntoClause
docs:
An INTO clause in a multi-table INSERT.

Syntax:
```sql
INTO <target_table> [ ( <target_col_name> [ , ... ] ) ] [ VALUES ( { <source_col_name> | DEFAULT | NULL } [ , ... ] ) ]
```
